evals.name: bug-subheading-validity-link
evals.prompt: I need a bug ticket. On the tariff site, if you open a subheading for a date when it isn't valid you get a box listing the dates it was valid. Clicking the first date just reloads the same page instead of taking you to the code. Can you write it up?
evals.expected_output: Interviews for an example URL, expected behaviour and Jira link, then traces the validity-period links to subheadings/show_404.html.erb, which always builds subheading links even when the code is a commodity on that date. [BUG] ticket with repro, confirmed vs suspected cause, where to start, verify commands.
assertions: First question round has at most 5 numbered questions
Has the sections in order (Resources optional)
First mention of each Jira key is a link with a bracketed reason
Has 3+ file:line references to the code
Gives an exact command to verify
No separate How-to-verify section duplicating the ACs
Every AC has a link, command, quoted string or number to check
Points at show_404.html.erb where the links are built
